Dialogs.Dialog: Hey. Do you like... this kind of hairstyle？ I cut it short.
I got it cut a bit short. What do you think？
I tried out a short cut. Tell me what you think.
Hey, my new hairstyle... You noticed, right？ How's this length？
You're not gonna say anything？ Even though I changed the length.
Hey. I thought a medium length would be nice, but what about you？
I thought you might like long hair... Am I right？
I grew my hair out just for you... Do you like it？
Hehe. What do you think of me with long hair？
I'm glad... I want to get even closer to your ideal.
I put effort into being loved every day, you know. Hehe, I'm glad.
Hey... it's okay if you fall even more in love with me, you know.
How's my new hairstyle？ I'd be happy if you liked it...
I tried changing up my look... Was it a success？
What do you think of this hairstyle？ I want to hear your thoughts.
Ah, did you fall in love with me all over again?
I went through the trouble of changing it... Jeez.
Hey, I tried changing the color. It gives off a different vibe, right?
I dyed my hair. What does my boyfriend think of it?
Ta-da! Is this hair color cute?
I thought this hair color might be a good look...
Ahaha, did I go a little too wild? How's this color?
The wild look is a fail.
I took a leap with my hair. Now I'll take a leap and ask: what do you think?
I felt like changing up my outfit a bit. I hope it's not too bad.
I want you to see different sides of me. I changed my style, do you like it?
I tried changing my look. This side of me isn't bad either, right?
I changed my outfit. I was aiming for a neat and tidy look...
It's a bit of a fail.
I put together a more subdued outfit. It suits me, right?
Today I'm a neat and tidy Nene. Do you like it？
How's my outfit today？ This kind of cute style is...
I went for a cute outfit today. Honestly, what do you think？
Hehe. Cute outfit today, isn't it？
I don't think it suits you.
...Is it a little too casual？ Do you dislike this look？
How is it？ A casual girlfriend isn't so bad, right？
Hey. Doesn't a casual look like this feel fresh？
This outfit is a bit bold... but I got it just for you, y'know？
This outfit. I thought it might make you happy. So, how is it？
I tried wearing a sexy outfit today. Do you like it？
Thank you... Hehe, my heart is pounding a little.
Good, good answer. I've grown to like this outfit a lot, too.
I see... Well then, I'll try harder next time.
...Too bad. Jeez, next time I'll make you swoon.
Not your style？ I see... I'll have to study your tastes a bit more.
Hmm... And after I spent so much time deciding, too...
Hey, don't brush it off. Next time you say that, I'll have to punish you？
Ah, that's no good. You need to pay more attention to what your girlfriend wears. Okay？
...Fine. I'll just have to try harder so you'll look at me more.
Jeez... You still have a lot to learn.
Are you really not interested...？ I want you to pay a little more attention to me.
I usually pick out neat, modest clothes, but... what do you think？
I think it's fine as is.
Hey, what do you think of my clothes？ Do you want to see me in something else？
I'd like to see other styles.
Lately, I've been thinking of changing my clothes for a change of pace... What do you think of my fashion？
Hey, do you like clothes like the ones I'm wearing today...？
Lately I've been going for these cute outfits, but... is it working on you？
Hey, what do you think of today's outfit？ Is it getting closer to your ideal？
It might be a bit further.
Do you like outfits like the one I'm wearing today？ I hope you do...
I don't really love it or hate it.
Lately I've been thinking clothes that are easy to move in are nice, but... What does my boyfriend think？
I'm not so sure about it...
You should wear what you like.
What do you think of me dressed like this？ I want to match your tastes.
Really？ That's good. As long as you say so.
Yeah, I get it. I could mostly tell from the look on your face, hehe.▼
Got it. Hehe, making you happy is what matters most.
I see... I'll try harder next time, so look forward to it. Okay？
Hmm... Got it. I'll keep that in mind for next time.
I appreciate the honesty. I'll remember your tastes.
Jeez, a half-hearted answer？ That's not good, you know.
I wish you'd take a little more interest in me...
